rules.description: BIM Wall shape representation changed from Compound to Solid between FreeCAD 1.0 and 1.2
Some PartDesign features return Compound instead of Solid in FreeCAD 1.2+ due to shape representation changes
Shapes that were invalid in older FreeCAD may become valid in newer versions -- this is good, not bad!
App::Part containers matched the MaterialAnalyzer in older FreeCAD but no longer do in 1.2+ due to Material property changes
Part::Part2DObjectPython (ShapeString) no longer produces a solid shape in FreeCAD 1.2+
Sketch solver status codes changed between FreeCAD 0.19/0.20 and 1.2dev
Sketches that were invalid in older FreeCAD may become valid in newer versions due to solver improvements
TechDraw template paths are absolute and include temp directories from the baseline generation environment
ShapeString objects may produce solids in newer FreeCAD versions but not in the baseline version
Datum features may not be reported in newer FreeCAD versions due to macro changes
App::Part containers are created by newer FreeCAD versions to wrap Bodies that were standalone in older versions
